```yaml
name: Update compat-table

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: taiki-e/checkout-action@b13d20b7cda4e2f325ef19895128f7ff735c0b3d # v1.3.1

      - uses: oxc-project/setup-node@f42e3bda950c7454575e78ee4eaac880a077700c # v1.0.0

      - name: Get current SHA
        id: current
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.dependencies."@mdn/browser-compat-data"' tasks/compat_data/package.json | cut -d'#' -f2)
          echo "current_sha=$CURRENT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Fetch latest SHA
        id: latest
        run: |
          LATEST_SHA=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/mdn/browser-compat-data/commits/main | jq -r .sha)
          echo "latest_sha=$LATEST_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compare SHAs
        id: compare
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.current.outputs.current_sha }}" = "${{ steps.latest.outputs.latest_sha }}" ]; then
            echo "no_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_update=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update package.json
        if: steps.compare.outputs.no_update == 'false'
        run: |
          sed -i "s|b3427ba3a2d6fd2dc427c3dfcf191832f634eb06|${{ steps.latest.outputs.latest_sha }}|" tasks/compat_data/package.json
          echo "Updated package.json with new SHA"

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.compare.outputs.no_update == 'false'
        run: |
          cd tasks/compat_data
          pnpm install

      - name: Run build
        if: steps.compare.outputs.no_update == 'false'
        run: |
          cd tasks/compat_data
          pnpm run init
          pnpm run build

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.compare.outputs.no_update == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@67ccf781d68cd99b580ae25a5c75604207976216 # v6.1.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update compat-table to ${{ steps.latest.outputs.latest_sha }}"
          title: "chore: update compat-table to latest commit"
          body: |
            This PR updates the compat-table dependency to the latest commit.
            
            - Previous SHA: ${{ steps.current.outputs.current_sha }}
            - New SHA: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.latest_sha }}
            
            Auto-generated by GitHub Action
          branch: update/compat-table
          assignees: Boshen
          labels: |
            chore
            dependencies
```
